title: Fixed 10-layer optimize existing stack route (SiO2/Ta2O5)
scientific_hypothesis: A fixed 10-layer SiO2/Ta2O5 stack tests whether the proposed optical mechanism can balance the shared spectral targets, total thickness, and manufacturing robustness.
design_principle: Global optimization of layer thicknesses for a 10-layer LHLHLH or HLHLHL stack. SiO2 is preferred as the outermost layer for environmental durability. Ta2O5 provides sufficient index contrast without the potential issues of TiO2 (stress/absorption).
proposed_topology: exactly 10 finite layers from the incident side: SiO2 / Ta2O5 / SiO2 / Ta2O5 / SiO2 / Ta2O5 / SiO2 / Ta2O5 / SiO2 / Ta2O5
manufacturing_considerations: Independent one-sigma thickness error of 2 nm
Common incidence-angle offset bounded by +/- 1 degree
theory_basis: Intermediate layer counts allow for finer control over the spectral shape than bilayers/trilayers, enabling better compensation for dispersion and angle-dependent phase shifts. Ta2O5/SiO2 is a standard, robust pairing for visible AR coatings.
expected_advantages: Good compromise between performance and complexity.
Likely to meet all soft objectives if topology is favorable.
known_risks: Topology constraint (starting with SiO2) might not be globally optimal; starting with Ta2O5 could yield better results.
Optimization landscape may have local minima requiring global search strategies.
execution_request_english: Perform one bounded TMM thickness-optimization route for Fixed 10-layer optimize existing stack route (SiO2/Ta2O5). Use these declared media constraints: substrate: fused-silica; ambient: air; candidate_coating_materials: MgF2, SiO2, Al2O3, Ta2O5, TiO2. Use exactly 10 finite layers from the incident side: SiO2 / Ta2O5 / SiO2 / Ta2O5 / SiO2 / Ta2O5 / SiO2 / Ta2O5 / SiO2 / Ta2O5. Optimize every finite layer physical thickness with finite positive bounds. Evaluate the wavelength, incidence-angle, polarization, soft-objective, and uncertainty controls supplied below. Report verified optical metrics, total thickness, and manufacturing robustness; targets rank candidates and never gate physical validity. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees, 30 degrees, 45 degrees. polarization TE, TM. wavelength intervals 450-700 nm. soft objectives: mean reflectance <= 0.8%; worst-case reflectance <= 3%; fewer layers; lower total physical thickness. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflectance. robustness conditions: independent one-sigma thickness error of 2 nm; common incidence-angle offset bounded by +/- 1 degree.
